name: Generic Invoice
description: Generic invoice or receipt. Detects invoice numbers, EU VAT IDs, IBAN, BIC/SWIFT (context-anchored), phone numbers (US and Canada with extensions, European and international), plus names, addresses, emails. Dates and amounts stay visible; toggle Amounts manually to hide totals too.

patterns.name: Invoice number
patterns.description: The invoice or receipt number after its label (Invoice No., Invoice #, Inv., INV-, Receipt No., Fattura n., Rechnung Nr., Rechnungsnummer, Facture n°, Factura nº, N°). Only codes with at least one digit are taken; the label word itself stays readable.

patterns.name: EU VAT Number
patterns.description: EU VAT number: 2-letter uppercase country code (optional space) + 8 to 12 digits.

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: BIC / SWIFT
patterns.description: BIC/SWIFT code together with its BIC: or SWIFT: label, so ordinary uppercase words are not taken.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Dates in DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, DD-MM-YY etc. Off by default, so invoice and service dates stay readable.

patterns.name: Phone
patterns.description: US and Canada numbers with area code (parentheses included), 7-digit local numbers like 555-0142, extensions (ext. 12, x12), international numbers with + or 00, and French, Italian, German, Spanish and UK formats. Plain digit runs only right after a phone label. Amounts, dates, ZIP codes, IBANs, mileage, VINs, part, invoice and account numbers are not taken.

patterns.name: Order number
patterns.description: Purchase order or order number starting with PO, ORDER or ORD, dashes inside allowed.
